profile_text.body:
Capgemini is a public company founded in 1967. On its own website it describes itself as a global leader in consulting, technology services and digital transformation, offering integrated services that combine technology with deep sector expertise. The site also highlights work in which AI surfaces new match insights in real time, giving fans a more complete and engaging view of the Rugby World Cup.

Beyond that description, the available material is thin. No specific AI products, MCP servers, or lawsuits are recorded for the company, and no SEC or patent facts are present.
